items.title: Are microplastics harming us?
items.summary: How much plastic do you use on a daily basis? And how much of it is used to package or prepare food? Recently, scientists are becoming increasingly concerned that microplastics, tiny bits of plastic invisible to the naked eye, are entering our bodies through these food sources… but it is unclear exactly what the long-term health effects will be. Becca and Phil discuss this and teach you some new vocabulary. 6 Minute English now has a VIDEO VERSION! It's the same programme that you know and love, but now you can see us!

items.title: Hegseth uses Venezuela visit to boast of Maduro’s capture by US military
items.summary: Defense secretary asserts US dominance on trip that would have seemed ‘impossible, almost unbelievable’ a year ago Pete Hegseth has used his first visit to Venezuela since US special forces abducted its former president, Nicolás Maduro, to boast of the dictator’s capture during what he called “the single most sophisticated military operation in the history of Latin America”. Maduro was controversially seized by Delta Force operatives in the early hours of 3 January, setting in motion an improbable rapprochement between Washington and Venezuela’s anti-imperialist “Chavista” regime, which has ruled since 1999.

items.title: Roll up, roll up! Marc Chagall’s Circus is the most mesmerising big top you’ve ever seen – review
items.summary: Hepworth Wakefield, West Yorkshire He spent over 60 years painting clowns, ringmasters and acrobats – and the results transport you to a dazzling magical world At the opening of The Circus, a self-portrait of Marc Chagall is placed next to a lithograph of a clown. The portrait is small and sketched simply in a blue crayon, as if Chagall had quickly dashed it out to pacify an inquisitive fan. In contrast, the clown is rich in colour and texture, with a heavily detailed backdrop of musicians, spectators and performers. But there is something uncanny about this pairing, created more than 40 years apart. They both wear small, brimmed hats with hair springing out from underneath, and their facial expressions are somewhat inscrutable. It is the perfect introduction to an exhibition that explores Chagall’s lifelong fascination with the circus, both as a subject and as a symbolic motif. In placing Chagall and the clown side by side, we understand this immediately – the clown is both a clown and a metaphor for the artist. In his 1967 art book Cirque, Chagall writes: “This clown – he is he and I.”

items.title: IPCC report delay will threaten global effort to tackle climate crisis, says top scientist
items.summary: Johan Rockström, one of world’s leading climate experts, says slowing down scientific work puts cooperation at risk Climate science is “foundational” to the Paris agreement and worldwide progress on tackling global heating, and attempts to delay new scientific reports threaten global cooperation on tackling the crisis, one of the world’s leading climate scientists has warned. Johan Rockström, the director of the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research, said the world’s leading body of climate scientists, the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, must be allowed to work as quickly as possible on its next comprehensive assessment of global knowledge of the climate systems .

items.title: Body found in Derry bog decapitated more than 2,000 years ago, coroner finds
items.summary: Inquest-style inquiry concludes iron age remains are of 15- to 22-year-old female who may have been ritually sacrificed A coroner’s investigation into Northern Ireland ’s most venerable cold case has concluded that the victim was decapitated more than 2,000 years ago. The inquest-style inquiry determined that Ballymacombs More Woman – the name given to iron age remains found in a County Derry bog three years ago – was between 15 and 22 years old when she was beheaded from behind with a bladed weapon.

items.title: Jan Mayensfield
items.summary: Jan Mayensfield ((ICAO: ENJA)) is an aerodrome or airfield in Jan Mayen, Norway. It is run by the Norwegian Armed Forces.
